verdict.rationale: Neon ships an official CLI that runs keylessly from npm. It can provision a project via `neon claim create`, which writes `DATABASE_URL` to `.env` for connecting, and it can inspect a database via `neon inspect db` (15 read-only checks). The evidence does not show an interactive SQL shell command or a general authenticated create/connect workflow. missing for 10: documented shell-into/psql command, documented general database/branch create and connection-string commands beyond the temporary claim flow, independent hands-on corroboration of the daily loop.

support.subject: As a developer, the official CLI covers my daily loop — create, connect, shell into, and inspect databases — without opening the dashboard

citations.quote: the official Neon CLI ran keylessly from npm
creates a temporary Neon project when there is no Neon account yet
The CLI writes `DATABASE_URL` (and granted service URLs) to `.env` or `.env.local`
exposes the same 15 read-only checks as `neon inspect db`
